INNER JOIN "event" T3 ON T2."link_to_event" = T3."event_id"

INNER JOIN "event" T3 ON T2."link_to_event" = T3."event_id"
WHERE T1."position" = 'Member'

SELECT AVG(T3."cost") 
FROM "member" T1
INNER JOIN "expense" T3 ON T1."member_id" = T3."link_to_member"
WHERE T1."first_name" ILIKE '%Elijah%'
  AND T1."last_name" ILIKE '%Allen%'
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T3."expense_date") IN (9, 10)

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN T2."event_name" = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1."amount" ELSE 0 END)::REAL
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN T1."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0)::REAL AS ratio
FROM "budget" T1
INNER JOIN "event" T2 ON T1."link_to_event" = T2."event_id"
WHERE T1."category" = 'Advertisement'
  AND (T2."event_name" ILIKE '%Yearly Kickoff%' OR T2."event_name" ILIKE '%October Meeting%')

SELECT DISTINCT T1."first_name", T1."last_name", T1."member_id", T3."link_to_event"
FROM "member" T1

INNER JOIN "attendance" T3 ON T1."member_id" = T3."link_to_member"
WHERE T2."approved" = 'true'
  AND T2."expense_date" BETWEEN TO_DATE('2019-01-10', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('2019-11-19', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY T1."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, T1."last_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, T1."member_id" ASC NULLS FIRST, T3."link_to_event" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT T1."first_name", T1."last_name", MAX(T3."cost") AS max_cost
FROM "member" T1
INNER JOIN "expense" T3 ON T1."member_id" = T3."link_to_member"
INNER JOIN "budget" T2 ON T3."link_to_budget" = T2."budget_id"
INNER JOIN "event" T4 ON T2."link_to_event" = T4."event_id"
GROUP BY T1."member_id", T1."first_name", T1."last_name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4."event_id") > 1
ORDER BY max_cost DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1
